cards.title: Stage 1 runs
cards.text: Maze, sight, moving, three test weapons, the dash, Mites and waves. Films of a bot playing it.
cards.why: This is the feel test before any spell system. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details:
A bot plays these films through the real touch controls, so the yellow dots are its thumbs.

No level-up choices, chests, modules, summon or other enemies yet: those are stages 2 to 4. Levels count up but give nothing.

The pause button (top middle) holds every setting below, so you can try them on the phone once it's online.

parts.title: Pistol
parts.text: Drag to aim, let go to fire one. A quick tap fires at the nearest enemy you can see. 6 rounds round the fire stick, refilling one by one after a short pause.

parts.title: SMG
parts.text: Hold and drag: keeps firing. Taps do nothing. 40 rounds, so the ring is one smooth bar instead of segments.

parts.title: Auto
parts.text: Fires at the nearest enemy you can see by itself. Drag to take over and aim.

parts.title: Dash
parts.text: Tap: dash where you're walking. Drag: aim it, let go. 2 charges. Can't be hit while dashing, and it shoves enemies aside.

parts.title: Crowds hold you
parts.text: Enemies never overlap, and they push back on you a little, so a packed corridor holds you until you dash or shoot through.

parts.title: Mites and waves
parts.text: Mites come from out of sight along the paths, more each minute. On every minute a wave comes from all sides. Easy on purpose, since there are no upgrades yet.

parts.title: Flat and solid
parts.text: Your pick: flat fills, no glow. You are white, enemies red, XP green, the rounds gold.

cards.title: Three kinds of sight
cards.text: The three you asked to try, all in settings: remembered, see all, and dark.
cards.why: Same moment, three settings. Mark the one you'd keep, or comment.

parts.title: Remembered
parts.text: What you've seen stays faint. Enemies out of sight are hidden; close ones show as a small red arrow beside you (you can turn the arrows off).

parts.title: See all
parts.text: The whole maze and every enemy, always.

parts.title: Dark
parts.text: Nothing outside your sight, not even walls you've passed.
